P_0x001AC8: One of Shu's subordinates, also known as "Saphine the Crimson." She appears to be a bewitching beauty, but harbors a number of perverse tastes. She intends to devote body and soul to Shu, though he remains cold toward her.
P_0x001BDC: Captain of the Langran Army's Ruzak Province border guard, holding the rank of lieutenant. A courteous, well-mannered man. He is a senior alumnus of the same military academy as Zeolute, Masaki's mentor.
P_0x001CA9: A surface dweller raised in the desert, pilot of the Elemental Soulgady. A man who can only find his place in life through battle, yet he seeks peace in his own way. Highly skilled at gathering information, he sometimes acts alone for that purpose.
P_0x001DD3: A Shutedonia soldier. Tomboyish in combat, but once she steps out of her Elemental, she becomes extremely timid. Normally very shy around others, she even blushes easily in social situations. She has feelings for Rodney.
P_0x001EDA: A soldier of the Holy Langran Kingdom. Once thought mediocre, believed to have become a general on lineage alone, he showed his true colors amid the chaos of war by keeping his own forces' losses to a minimum. Bold, yet also a solid tactician.
P_0x001FF1: Kirkus's eldest son and a soldier of the Holy Langran Kingdom. Earnest and personable, though somewhat timid in daily life. He has fallen at first sight for Lune. Commonly known as Zash.
